analyzed_vuln.description: `SendBuffered` passes `outputBuffer.length` as the send size while the data pointer is offset by `outputBuffer.idx`. If `idx` is non-zero, this asks the IO callback to read more bytes than remain in the buffer tail (`length` bytes from `buffer+idx` instead of `length-idx`), causing an out-of-bounds read. The fuzzer’s `fuzzer_send`/`memory_test` detects this via `fwrite`.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In the DTLS client-randomize harness, crafted input drives DTLS 1.3 retransmission/output buffering so that `ssl->buffers.outputBuffer.idx` becomes non-zero while `length` is still positive (e.g., partial writes / buffered retransmit path through `Dtls13RtxSendBuffered` -> `CheckAvailableSize` -> `SendBuffered`). Then `SendBuffered` invokes `CBIOSend` with pointer `buffer + idx` and size `length`, leading to read past the allocated output buffer end (observed 400-byte allocation, 160-byte over-read starting exactly at end).
